title: Tip from Angela - How to Deal with Procrastination
summary: Short study-habit tip: avoid ritual preparation before working, start immediately, and reward yourself afterwards. Suggests the Pomodoro Technique.

concepts.heading: Key takeaways
points: Elaborate setup rituals (tidying the desk, snacks, tea) are themselves a form of delay and reward the avoidance habit.
Treat procrastination like a habit that strengthens when fed: start the work first, take the treat afterwards.
Pomodoro Technique: work for 25 minutes with a timer, then take a 5-minute break. Keep small distractions for the break so both work and rest get full attention.
